$comment: Share images and social posts. Layouts and opening copy follow the brand's image tool in agd-playground (src/components/opencommerce-og/draw.ts and Editor.tsx, routes opencommerce-og-image-playground and opencommerce-social-post). The four layouts there are hero, window, closing and cards; the CLI keeps its earlier five (headline, lead, frame, quote, announcement) beside them. Sizes are the tool's six plus the social set; each has the width it is usually shown at (the text floor comes from it), the area its platform leaves clear, and the platform's upload limit. Colors, radii, shadows, faces, tracking and line heights come from brand/tokens.css; where the tool's literals disagree, the token wins (see notes). Pixel sizes are the tool's, in the 1200x630 preview's pixels, grown with the image's area (unit k).

notes: Line heights: the tool sets headlines at 1.04 and the line under them at 1.5; the tokens say --ds-leading-heading 1.02 and --ds-leading-lead 1.55, and the CLI uses the tokens.

Window drop: the tool's canvas shadow is rgba(23,24,24,0.22) with a 32px blur and no spread; the CLI draws --ds-shadow-card (a hairline drop and 0 12px 32px -20px at 22 percent), so the drop is tighter than the tool's.
Headline weight: the tool sets the display face at 500; the CLI outlines the bundled substitute (TeX Gyre Heros, one weight), since Neue Haas Grotesk Display is not licensed to ship.
Attribution chip: the tool draws Agentcard's own lockup after 'Product by'. That lockup is not a file in brand/logo, so the CLI typesets the maker's name in the display face instead.
Merchants: the tool can fill the window with sixteen store logos (public/opencommerce-og). Those are third-party marks and are not shipped; the window takes code or your own --image.
Lockup: the tool follows the name with 'Product by' and Agentcard's lockup; the CLI uses brand/logo/lockup.svg (the name and 'by Agentcard').
The window arrow is typed in the platform mono; the bundled mono has no such glyph, so it is drawn from Inter.
Hero window: the tool runs the window off the bottom edge and cuts it. The CLI draws code whole, and fades a picture window that leaves the canvas.
Opening copy: the tool opens with its own chip, headline and code. The CLI draws only the copy it is given; --sample fills the sample copy.
Comments in code: the site's faint ink (2.7:1 on white) fails for text this small, so images set them in --ds-color-text-secondary on white and --ds-color-text-faint on the dark window.
Logo clear space and smallest size: brand/ has no printed rule, so they are the site header's own (see logo).

floor.$comment: Small text is at least 8 px at the width an image is usually shown (sizes.shown); sizes with no listed width use the custom widths. Large text (3:1 contrast) starts at 24 px on a 1200 px wide image.

logo.source: The site header sets the name at 17px and pads its tray 9px round it (registry site-header: pt-2.25): no smaller, and no closer.
